lady.summary: The model is the court lady with the red bun, the pearl tiara, the green gown, and the raised fan. The skirt shape is a clear difference from the round bell gown in the mockup.
strengths: The red hair bun with the pearl tiara matches the mockup closely.
The face reads well: warm brown eyes, blush, and a small closed smile.
The sage green gown, the cream front panel, and the lace collar match the mockup palette.
The raised fan with pink flowers reads in every sprite direction.
issues: The skirt is a stiff pyramid with sharp corners at the hem. Make a round bell skirt with soft folds, as in the mockup.
The small green purse sits at the skirt hem, away from the hand, and looks dropped. Put the purse in the left fist at hip height.
The back of the skirt is flat and wide in the back view. Give the back of the skirt a round, full volume.
The mockup shows a pearl necklace. Add a short pearl necklace above the lace collar.
In the walk clip, the skirt hides all leg motion and the body only bobs. Add a small sway to the skirt hem.
lady.next: Change the pyramid skirt to a round bell skirt with soft folds.

lord.summary: The model is the cheerful lord with a beard, a navy doublet, a fur-lined cape, and a raised silver goblet. The hair texture and the small ruff are clear differences from the mockup.
strengths: The open, laughing smile and the curled mustache match the mockup expression.
The navy doublet with silver buttons and the belt buckle match the mockup.
The raised goblet gives a clear, proud pose that reads in the sprites.
The fur lining and the cape cloth read as different materials.
issues: The hair is a mass of rope-like coils that read as dreadlocks. Make swept-back wavy hair with one side curl, as in the mockup.
The white ruff collar is small, and the beard hides it. Make a large white ruff that shows above the doublet.
The beard is long and covers the upper chest. Make the beard shorter so that the ruff and the top buttons show.
The cape is dark maroon. Use the brighter red of the mockup and keep the fur at the cape edges.
lord.next: Change the coiled hair to swept-back wavy hair with one side curl.

noble.summary: The model is the young noble with a teal wide-brim hat, a white plume, a teal coat, a gold waistcoat, and a cane. The plume shape, the face, and the hidden breeches are clear differences from the mockup.
strengths: The teal hat and coat, the gold waistcoat, and the white jabot match the mockup palette.
The black cane with the crook handle and the gold bands matches the mockup.
The wide hat brim gives a strong silhouette in every view and in the sprites.
The white cuffs give clear accents at the hands.
issues: The plume is a flat white shape with finger-like lobes, and it reads as a glove in the front view. Make a soft, curved feather that bends back over the brim.
The coat covers the legs down to the shoes, so the cream breeches of the mockup do not show. Open the coat front below the waist and add cream breeches.
The heavy dark brows and the side smirk make the face sharper than the soft smile in the mockup. Use thinner brows and a centered smile.
The hair is short and dark brown. Use the longer auburn waves of the mockup that show under the brim.
noble.next: Change the glove-like plume to a soft, curved feather.

leader.summary: The model is the town leader with a red coat, a green sash, a raised fist, and a tall green banner. The black and white spiky hair is a clear difference from the grey hair in the mockup.
strengths: The red coat with gold buttons and the green sash with gold edges match the mockup.
The tall banner and the raised fist give a clear rallying pose.
The warm open grin reads in the front and three-quarter sprites.
The banner gives a strong silhouette in every view.
issues: The hair is black with white spiky tufts on top. Make full grey hair with darker grey streaks, as in the mockup.
A large grey spike points down at the back of the head. Make the back hair a smooth, layered mass.
Two upper teeth show at the corners of the mouth and can read as small fangs. Make one even row of upper teeth.
The banner pole is light gold. Use the darker wood brown of the mockup pole.
leader.next: Change the hair to full grey hair with darker grey streaks.

masked-agent.summary: The model is the hooded agent with a purple hood, a dark coat, a white half mask, and a sealed letter. The mask reads as goggles and shows a skin spot, so the face is the largest difference.
strengths: The deep purple hood and capelet and the dark grey double-breasted coat match the mockup palette.
The sealed letter with the purple wax seal reads clearly in the hand and in the sprites.
The friendly smile keeps the character playful and never scary.
The black fringe under the hood matches the mockup.
issues: A skin-colored spot shows through the center of the mask above the eyes. Close the mask surface so that it is fully white.
The mask is a narrow band with round eye holes and gold rims, and it reads as goggles. Make a broader half mask that covers the nose bridge, as in the mockup.
The hood is a large round dome, and the cloak stops at the knees. Give the hood a soft point and make the cloak long to the ankles.
The free hand hangs at the side. Raise the free hand to the chin, as in the mockup.
The back view and the back sprites show only a plain purple shape. Add folds and a hem edge to the back of the cloak.
masked-agent.next: Close the skin spot in the mask and extend the mask over the nose bridge.
